description: Israel continues to deny UN investigators access to detention facilities and to Gaza. Every figure in this category is therefore a floor rather than an estimate.
energy_note: Every number here is the minimum.

aspect: Verified cases are explicitly described as indicative, not exhaustive
description: The 2026 Secretary-General's report states verified cases should be understood as indicative of a broader pattern rather than an exhaustive list. That caveat is doing a great deal of work.
energy_note: A sample, presented as a sample, read as a total.

aspect: Blackouts remove the ability to document from inside
description: Where connectivity is cut, events cannot be recorded, transmitted or verified at the time, and testimony gathered later is discounted precisely for being later.
energy_note: Unable to record it, then disbelieved for having no recording.

aspect: Which produces a permanent evidentiary asymmetry
description: One party has full documentary capability and access to the territory; the other has neither. Any adjudication that weighs documented evidence will systematically favour the better-documented account.
energy_note: A trial where only one side was allowed a camera.

aspect: And for the individual, being disbelieved is its own injury
description: Survivors consistently describe official and social disbelief as harder than the events, because it converts an injury into a question about their honesty.
energy_note: Asked, politely, whether any of it happened.

aspect: EXAMPLE - the access refusal, stated by the UN
description: The 2026 Secretary-General's report on conflict-related sexual violence states that verified cases should be understood as indicative of a broader pattern rather than an exhaustive list, particularly as Israel continues denying UN investigators access to detention facilities and to Gaza.
energy_note: The UN saying, in its own report, that it was not allowed to count.
